name: IG-227 Hailfire-class droid tank
description: The IG-227 Hailfire-class droid tank, also known as the IG-227 Hailfire Tank, hailfire droid, wheel droid, or simply Hailfires, was a model of droid tank manufactured by Haor Chall Engineering Corporation that was used by the InterGalactic Banking Clan and Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars as well as the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War.

data.name: IG-227 Hailfire-class droid tank
armament: Long-range "Hailfire" missile launcher pods (2) (15 guided missiles each, 30 total)
